summary: FTAI Infrastructure Inc. (FIP) via its subsidiaries Ohio River Partners Holdco LLC and Ohio River Partners Finance LLC entered an equity purchase agreement to sell all membership interests of Long Ridge Energy Power LLC to MARA USA Corporation for a base purchase price of $1.512 billion, subject to customary adjustments. $20 million will be escrowed for post-closing adjustments. The agreement includes customary reps, warranties, covenants, a non-solicitation clause, and a requirement for buyer to obtain debt financing. A break fee or specific premium is not disclosed. The filing is an 8-K reporting a material definitive agreement. The transaction is a divestiture of a subsidiary for cash, subject to regulatory approvals; watch for antitrust review timeline.
